'''An unidentified Valorum''' was a member of the [[House Valorum/Legends|Valorum family]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], some time prior to [[62 BBY/Legends|62 BBY]].<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] remembered that "([[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]]) ''election to the chancellorship had more to do with a pedigree that included three Supreme Chancellors'' ([[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], [[Eixes Valorum]] and an unidentified individual) ''and deals he had cut with infuential families like the [[Kalpana family|Kalpanas]] and the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkins]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]''."<ref name="Plagueis" />
